root: ^Delliah. For years, she healed with the trust of others more than with herbs. She knew the names of plants, but she didn't know the limits of her own knowledge. When the real illness came, she was left all alone, with empty hands and overly proud tongue.
^I always keep what I borrow close to my heart.

^I let her stay. She spoke of knowledge as if it were something owned, not earned. Her hands knew poisons as well as cures, yet she called both wisdom. She believed herself clever until the very end. Perhaps that belief is what kept her standing when everyone else fell. The Train feels heavier tonight.
